holds.name: node
holds.reason: The 2026-10-09 and 2026-10-10 Node nightlies publish no win-x64 build (only osx/linux/aix), so pnpm cannot provision devEngines.runtime on this repo's Windows host and CI leg (ERR_PNPM_PACKAGE_MANAGER_NO_MATCHING_PLATFORM_VARIANT). 2026-10-08 is the newest nightly with win-x64. Recheck every sweep; move as soon as a newer nightly ships win-x64.
